name: Nenshou! For Girls
source: “Burn your fat with me!!” series is a fitness app/dating sim that provides players with the motivation to work out through moé, a Japanese term describing that heart-melting feeling you get when you see an adorable female anime character.
translation: “跟我一起燃烧你的脂肪吧！！”系列是一款健身应用/约会模拟游戏，通过“moé”为玩家提供锻炼的动力，“moé”是一个日语术语，描述当你看到可爱的女性动漫角色时所获得的令人心碎的感觉。
